title: Operator toggle check confirms fire-mode predictions

leads.title: Operator toggle check confirms fire-mode predictions
leads.summary: Operator confirmed in game (no recording) that all 11 named loadout toggle predictions from L604 match: M4A1 bare auto/single; M16A4 bare burst/single and A3 Receiver auto/single; KORD 6P67 Burst Training burst/auto/single; GRT-BC and SL9 Burst Mode burst/single; VSSM bare single and Folding Stock auto/single; GRT-CPS bare single; vz. 61 bare auto/single; M2010 ESR bare bolt single. The per-weapon mode table in fire-modes.json is accepted as the selector's mode source.
leads.reopenWhen: A game update changes a weapon's WB mode lists or a mode-changing attachment.
